I replied to Pree in a thread on her correction in #central-team: "Thanks Pree, updated: the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47, not Dock 23. Please disregard the earlier note."

The site on record is now Gate 47. My earlier "Dock 23" reply is still in this morning's thread, but the correction says to ignore it. She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.
